title: User and Identity Domain Model
description: Reusable JSON Schema definitions for student profiles, instructors or educators, linked Google SSO identities, preferences, communication settings, and user security sessions.

StudentProfile.title: Student Profile
StudentProfile.description: Primary domain entity capturing student identity, linked Google SSO provider credentials, preferences, timezone, and communication settings.

id.description: Stable identifier for the student profile.

identity.description: Identity information associated with the student profile.

googleSsoCredentials.description: Linked Google Single Sign-On identity associated with the student profile.

preferences.description: Preferences associated with the student's experience.

timezone.description: Timezone associated with the student's profile.

communicationSettings.description: Settings governing communication with the student.

email.description: Email address representing the student's identity.

fullName.description: Name by which the student is identified.

GoogleSsoCredentials.title: Google SSO Credentials
GoogleSsoCredentials.description: Information linking the student profile to a Google Single Sign-On identity.

provider.description: Identity provider associated with the linked Single Sign-On identity.

providerSubject.description: Subject identifier assigned by Google to the linked identity.

linkedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the Google identity was linked to the student profile.

StudentPreferences.title: Student Preferences
StudentPreferences.description: Preferences associated with the student's experience.

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the student's experience.

CommunicationSettings.title: Communication Settings
CommunicationSettings.description: Settings governing communication with the student.

emailNotificationsEnabled.description: Indicates whether email communications are enabled for the student.

Instructor.title: Instructor / Educator
Instructor.description: Domain entity representing a content creator or instructor assigned to manage or deliver specific courses.

id.description: Stable identifier for the instructor or educator.

assignedCourseIds.description: Identifiers referencing courses assigned to the instructor for management or delivery.

UserSession.title: User Session
UserSession.description: Active or historical security session tracking authentication method, IP address, device fingerprint, and authorization tokens.

id.description: Stable identifier for the user session.

userId.description: Identifier referencing the identity associated with the security session.

authenticationMethod.description: Authentication method used to establish the session.

ipAddress.description: IP address associated with the security session.

deviceFingerprint.description: Device fingerprint associated with the security session.

authorizationTokens.description: Authorization token values associated with the security session.

startedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the security session was established.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the security session expires, when an expiration time applies.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the security session is currently active.
